original_findings_json.text: The credit policy explicitly covers digital lending, microfinance, and housing finance, but does not address Gold Metal Loans or NBFC financing.
EMI operational guidelines have been rolled out to 8 of 12 branches; remaining 4 branches are pending rollout.
Q3 quarterly review of active loans against weight-limit policy was not completed within the prescribed timeline.
Q2 review of valuation policy effectiveness was completed 3 weeks after the scheduled date, with no documented reason for the delay.
The most recent periodic risk evaluation of LSP operations is 2 months overdue against the policy-mandated schedule.
Key Fact Statement distribution to customer-facing staff has not yet been completed at 2 of 15 branches.
